claim: Every op in lx106::supports() is in the LX106 configuration's opcode table, and no other decoder op is accepted. tests/lx106.rs LX106_OPS holds one instance per op with its opcodes[] line; every_lx106_opcode_is_supported_and_executes and supported_encodings_are_only_lx106_opcodes pin the list in both directions.

opcode_table.core_isa_h_note: Same option values as the Arduino 3.1.2 header in sources.json; differs only by a customer-ID comment and commented-out ROM/reset-vector lines.

table_ops_not_in_profile.simcall: Illegal on hardware before RE.3: QEMU translate.c:2240-2253 (hw_version <= 250002); LX106 XCHAL_HW_VERSION is 230001 (core-isa.h:131).
table_ops_not_in_profile.rfdo, rfdd: XTENSA_OP_ILL in QEMU (translate.c:3673-3674, 3680-3681); OCD halt mode is not modelled.
table_ops_not_in_profile.wsr.mmid: Needs XTENSA_OPTION_TRACE_PORT (translate.c:5297-5304), which no QEMU core overlay enables (overlay_tool.h).
table_ops_not_in_profile.mov: Assembler alias of OR; the decoder returns Op::Or, so Op::Mov in supports() is unreachable from bytes.

assembler.differences_from_test_bytes: rer/wer: this config's table gives them no operands (opcodes 0x406000/0x407000); the test sets t=a2, s=a3 per the ISA RRR format. l32r: the test uses displacement -4 instead of the linked literal.

negatives.note: Each line assembled alone with each config (exit status of xtensa-esp-elf-as).

dhi a2, 0.encoding: ISA CACHE format; dc233c table line 9179 (0x7062 with s=0)

ihi a2, 0.encoding: ISA CACHE format; dc233c table line 9101 (0x70e2 with s=0)
